BiblicalUsage: Pilcha is named once, in Nehemiah 10:24, as a chief of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah — listed among Hallohesh and Shobek in the sealed document. One line, one signature, one man who put his name to the promise.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God remembers the men who sign, not only the men who speak.
